primaryAuthority: Each state's Department of Revenue; Tax Foundation, State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets (2026)
coverageModel: v1 FLAT-RATE. Only the nine states with no broad-based personal income tax are modeled as data (0% on ordinary income, including Roth conversions). For every other state the engine applies an ADVISOR-SUPPLIED flat effective marginal rate and never guesses a state's rate or brackets (Rule 4).

stateCaveats.WA: Washington levies a tax on certain long-term capital gains above an annual threshold but does NOT tax ordinary income or Roth conversions. Ordinary-income rate is 0 here; the capital-gains tax is out of scope for this flat-rate v1.
stateCaveats.NH: New Hampshire's Interest & Dividends tax finished phasing out on 2025-01-01; from 2026 there is no state tax on any income, including Roth conversions.
stateCaveats.TN: Tennessee's Hall tax on interest and dividends was fully repealed effective 2021.

advisorSuppliedRate.mechanism: For any state NOT in noOrdinaryIncomeTaxStates, the advisor supplies a single effective marginal state rate for the household. The engine applies it as a flat rate to incremental ordinary income (Roth conversions and taxable withdrawals).

machineVerification: 2026-08-21: the nine no-income-tax states (AK, FL, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY) were cross-verified against multiple independent secondary sources, including the NH interest-and-dividends phase-out completing 2025-01-01. No per-state rate is embedded, so nothing here is guessed. Human advisor sign-off still recommended.
